# City of Arcadia, California

> > Official government website for the City of Arcadia, California, providing access to municipal services, public resources, and city administration.

The City of Arcadia is located in Los Angeles County, California. This portal serves as the central hub for residents and visitors to access city services, including the Arcadia Public Library, Arcadia Police Department, and the Gilb Museum of Arcadia Heritage.

## Key Topics

- City of Arcadia
- Municipal services
- City government
- Arcadia Public Library
- Arcadia Police Department
- Gilb Museum of Arcadia Heritage

- Los Angeles County
- California local government

- City administration
- Resident services
